productFrame.classification: existing HOW realization correction; no new Product outcome, authority, public contract or runtime entity

rootCause.origin: One test helper imposed the late invocation-admission oracle on distinct early input/observation refusal boundaries.
rootCause.observed: Crossed input returned invalid_input at /input; test expected invalid_intent.
rootCause.staticSecondMismatch: Consumed Testing source after UAT returns invalid_input at /observation.
rootCause.whyMissed: Earlier setup failures prevented reaching these assertions; controlled mocks did not establish actual Public gate ordering.

selectedRepair.implementation: Use the existing helper with one exact expected code/path tuple per case; no allowed-code union/fallback.
selectedRepair.immediateProof: Each invocation must immediately prove refusal, unchanged COMPLETE prefix/full event delta, and unchanged actor log. Filtered diagnostic events are insufficient.
selectedRepair.ordering: Keep current-source negative invocations before UAT; stale invocation remains after UAT before close. Defer ONLY code/path assertions until after successful UAT and held/fresh checks. Every deferred assertion remains mandatory and fails the final test on mismatch. Emit the existing positive-path diagnostic before deferred assertions.
forbidden: broad or glob searches beyond selected source paths

nativeExecution.stop: Any unexpected Product/architecture failure, unsafe reuse, source/scope mismatch or out-of-scope repair returns to Root; no retry.

proofOrder.first: Actual installed Testing -> admitted state Result -> UAT, including complete held/fresh agreement.
proofOrder.second: Existing HS02 installed ordinary-consumer/held-session case, because the changed unconditional setup affects that path; its previous accepted evidence stays historical.
proofOrder.remaining: Previously unconsumed affected assessment, workspace-owner and caller lanes.
proofOrder.allowedHistoricalSkip: admitted pure consumer evaluates a native task as data without physical authority
proofOrder.newTests: No new mirror test is selected; use the existing affected integration/counter cases.

buildEvidenceReuse.selection: Reference the existing H04 inventory and completed H03 Product build. One isolated451-source stage; all450 non-writable sources unchanged from H04 baseline.
buildEvidenceReuse.owner: Existing pinned RC6 shared/digests and canonical_json

readScope: Use exact pinned owner/test paths from the closed review; all seven cited paths are within451 sources. No broad glob/Grep. Preserve H04 read-scope disclosure.
acceptanceBoundary: Root conjoins exact source/native.after/stage/live/close, independent max frozen review and five selected lanes before HS01/02 acceptance or HS03 activation.
